per_proof_checks.mathematical_check: Publicly derives the finite chain mass t^(2n)/(2n)! by recursion/Beta integration including order zero, measurability using Green measures rather than sphere densities, positive bounded common-width source covariance and uniform Gaussian product moments. These give Bochner integrability and two-chain absolute Fubini. Positive-width Green smoothing is removed through bounded continuous Wick products, weak convergence with mass preservation, time domination and square/cross moments; the vertexwise q_n bound is specialized at common widths. All unequal/empty chain/self pairings keep one [0,1] mask factor per vertex, giving diagram comparison and diagonal q_n norm bounds, without arbitrary covariance or samplewise solution order.

Publicly checks absolute L2 series via Q_t, local compact-cone Picard bounds M^n T^(2n)/(2n)!, continuity and iterated difference uniqueness. Fixed-point Bochner/pathwise identification and L1 convergence of products justify summing all mixed orders under Q_t². Only the unmasked stationary law is used for the two-point second-moment bound. Translation of vertex positions, L2-continuity of finite terms and uniform q_n tails give a separable image and Bochner spatial integration; nonnegative phi and the exact volume-free ||phi||1² bound are retained. The literal an/a Bochner correction is explicitly recognized and has no mathematical effect.

Finally the L2 norm-difference estimate passes the source inequality only under the stated masked-average convergence premise.
